data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate capital appreciation through investment in equity and equity relatedinstruments. The Scheme will seek to generate capital appreciation by investing in an active portfolio of stocks selected on thebasis of a Quant model. There is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved
data.asset_allocation: Equity & Equity Related Instruments - 80%-100% & Debt & Money Market Instruments - 0%-20%, Units issued by REITs andInvITs - 0%-10%
data.exit_load: 0.25% if redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 1 month from the date of allotment of units.Nil, thereafter.
